items.title: Alvin Queen interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 23, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: it’s with Houston Person. He’s playing tenor saxophone on that.

ctx.x: I have to mention, Junior Mance, he had an album called “Harlem Lullaby?” One of my favorite tunes of all times.
Get the new CD, “Live at the Town Hall” we did that, it’s one of the best cuts on the album, it’s with Houston Person. He’s playing tenor saxophone on that.
